analysisSummary: Customer portal architecture diagram showing client interactions from a Browser into AWS. Static asset traffic flows through CloudFront to an S3 assets bucket. API traffic flows through an HTTP API Gateway to a 'business' AWS Lambda function, which performs read and write operations against an Amazon DynamoDB table.
detectedRelationships: Browser sends asset requests to Amazon CloudFront
CloudFront uses Amazon S3 assets as an origin
Browser invokes Amazon API Gateway HTTP API
HTTP API invokes the 'business' Lambda function
Lambda function 'business' reads from and writes to DynamoDB
